query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'sourceId',source_id,'mode',mode,'status',status, 'checkpointBefore',checkpoint_before,'checkpointAfter',checkpoint_after,'recordsSeen',records_seen, 'recordsChanged',records_changed,'startedAt',started_at,'completedAt',completed_at, 'reportAvailable',report_object_key IS NOT NULL,'errorDetail',error_detail,'version',version, 'retryOfSourceRunId',retry_of_source_run_id,'requestedFrom',requested_from, 'requestedTo',requested_to,'requestReason',request_reason) FROM ops.source_runs WHERE id=$1
